title: Concept: Card expiry date served in a response
description: A card expiry month and year next to card wording in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: An expiry date is one of the three values a card-not-present transaction needs, and it is useless to the customer but valuable alongside a leaked number.
applicability: Card management, subscription billing and saved-card pages.
risk: Expiry dates complete partial card data that leaks through other channels such as receipts and support tickets.
